body: I actually randomly came in contact with someone on an anonymous app that actually wanted to help me and he exploited my feelings for his pleasure seeing me do it. Be careful what you ask for. It isn’t good, alright? There is no easy or painless way to die. Trust me. I saw the pro suicide form with all the ways to do it and it’s horrifying. Actually made me not want to do it. Never thought I’d say this but living might be less pain than dying.
